Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying the nursing home certificate of bed need ratio.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to modifying the nursing home certificate of bedneed ratio; adding a new section to chapter 70.38 RCW; providing aneffective date; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.38 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In determining the need for nursing home beds on a statewide basisand a planning area specific basis, the department shall calculate theneed for nursing home beds based on the bedtopopulation ratio offorty beds per one thousand persons age seventy and older.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJuly 1, 2007.
